novelty.justification: The claim hypothesizes that models "linearly represent a 'being evaluated vs. deployed' variable" that "causally modulates safety-relevant behavior," so its novelty route is a mechanistic operationalization of evaluation awareness rather than a new behavioral setting. Searches for "LLM evaluation awareness linear probe," "evaluation versus deployment activation steering," "situational awareness model internals," and "alignment faking representation probe" identify Greenblatt et al.'s Alignment Faking in Large Language Models, Laine et al.'s Measuring Situational Awareness in LLMs, Hubinger et al.'s Sleeper Agents, and Zou et al.'s Representation Engineering as the closest foundations: they respectively establish context-sensitive evaluation/deployment behavior, behavioral situational awareness, deployment-triggered deception, and linear activation interventions. Moving from those works to probing and steering an evaluation-awareness direction is a non-trivial but natural combination and operationalization—not a new core relationship or measurement paradigm—because linear decoding and causal activation steering are being used for their standard purpose on a more specific safety-related latent variable.
